posts.title: The Chilean Navy’s Pigeon Service, 1898–1904

posts.title: Pigeons in the Siege of Antwerp, 1832
posts.description: The Franco-Prussian War of 1870-71 is perhaps the most well known instance of pigeons being used to carry information in and out of a city during a siege. But nearly 40 years earlier, the Dutch military used pigeons in a similar fashion during the Siege of Antwerp in 1832. In this post, we examine the […]

posts.title: Pigeons in the Hut Tax War of Sierra Leone, 1898
posts.description: When did the British Army first use pigeons in combat? World War One? The Boer War? The answer is the Hut Tax War of 1898, a relatively obscure colonial uprising in Sierra Leone.
